svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: ReactionFlow
svg.desc: ReactionFlow: automated reaction discovery and pathway refinement for atomistic trajectories. A molecular-dynamics trajectory on an energy surface leaves the reactant basin and settles in the product basin; the refined minimum-energy path between the two basins passes over the saddle point.
